nestedUI.title: _build_dag(config_path: Path) -> DAG
nestedUI.body: """Build one DAG: customer.yaml -> trino_ingestion__customer."""    config = _load_config(config_path)    dag_id = _dag_id(config_path)    source = sql._quoted_relation(config, "source")    target = sql._quoted_relation(config, "target")    ingestion_dag() -> None    return ingestion_dag()

nestedUI.title: ingestion_dag() -> None
nestedUI.tooltip:
@dag(
        dag_id=dag_id,
        description=(
            f"Scheduled Oracle-to-Iceberg {config['write_mode']} load "
            f"of {target} from {source}"
        ),
        schedule=config["schedule"],
        start_date=datetime(2026, 9, 14, tzinfo=DAG_TIMEZONE),
        catchup=False,
        is_paused_upon_creation=False,
        max_active_runs=1,
        max_active_tasks=1,
        dagrun_timeout=timedelta(minutes=20),
        default_args={"retries": 3},
        params={
            "mode": Param(
                config["write_mode"],
                type="string",
                enum=sorted(configuration.SUPPORTED_WRITE_MODES),
                title="Mode",
                description="Load strategy. Examples: overwrite, batch_incremental.",
                examples=["overwrite", "batch_incremental"],
            ),
            "primary_key": Param(
                config["primary_key"],
                type=["null", "string"],
                pattern=configuration.IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.pattern,
                title="Primary key",
                description=(
                    "Required for batch_incremental. Example: CUSTOMER_ID."
                ),
                examples=["CUSTOMER_ID"],
            ),
            "incremental_col": Param(
                config["incremental_col"],
                type=["null", "string"],
                pattern=configuration.IDENTIFIER_PATTERN.pattern,
                title="Incremental column",
                description=(
                    "Required for batch_incremental and must be DATE or TIMESTAMP. "
                    "Example: UPDATED_AT."
                ),
                examples=["UPDATED_AT"],
            ),
            "window_boundary": Param(
                config["window_boundary"],
                type=["null", "string"],
                pattern=configuration.WINDOW_BOUNDARY_PATTERN.pattern,
                title="Window boundary",
                description=(
                    "Required for batch_incremental in HH:MM local DAG time. "
                    "Example: 13:30."
                ),
                examples=["13:30"],
            ),
            "partition_columns": Param(
                config["partition_columns"],
                type=["null", "array"],
                items={"type": "string"},
                uniqueItems=True,
                title="Partition columns (overwrite only)",
                description_md=(
                    "**Overwrite only. Enter one partition field per line.**\n\n"
                    "- `STATUS`: group rows by each exact status value.\n"
                    "- `bucket(CUSTOMER_ID, 16)`: hash customer IDs into 16 groups.\n\n"
                    "To use both, enter:\n\n"
                    "```text\nSTATUS\nbucket(CUSTOMER_ID, 16)\n```\n\n"
                    "Keep the prefilled YAML values, or clear the field for no partitioning. "
                    "Ignored for batch_incremental."
                ),
            ),
            "schema_evolution": Param(
                config["schema_evolution"],
                type="boolean",
                title="Schema evolution (batch only)",
                description=(
                    "Defaults to YAML, or true when omitted. "
                    "On: add missing source and audit columns before MERGE. "
                    "Off: fail before ALTER or MERGE if target columns are missing. "
                    "Existing types, drops and renames are not reconciled. "
                    "Ignored for overwrite."
                ),
                examples=[True, False],
            ),
        },
        tags=[
            "ingestion",
            "trino",
            str(config["write_mode"]),
            str(config["source_catalog"]),
            str(config["target_catalog"]),
        ],
    )

nestedUI.title: trino_ingestion_dag_factory.py
nestedUI.body: """Build scheduled Oracle-to-Iceberg ingestion DAGs from YAML configurations."""from __future__ import annotationsfrom collections.abc import Mappingfrom datetime import datetime, timedeltafrom pathlib import Pathimport refrom zoneinfo import ZoneInfoimport yamlfrom airflow.sdk import DAG, Param, dagfrom croniter import croniterfrom ingestion.common import configuration, operators, sqlCONFIG_DIR = Path(__file__).with_name("config_oracle2iceberg")TRINO_CONN_ID = "trino_default"DAG_TIMEZONE = ZoneInfo("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh")IDENTIFIER_KEYS = (    "source_catalog",    "source_schema",    "source_table",    "target_catalog",    "target_schema",    "target_table",)REQUIRED_KEYS = frozenset(    (*IDENTIFIER_KEYS, "write_mode", "schedule", "k8s_requests", "k8s_limits"))OPTIONAL_KEYS = frozenset(    {        "partition_columns",        "primary_key",        "incremental_col",        "window_boundary",        "schema_evolution",    })ALLOWED_KEYS = REQUIRED_KEYS | OPTIONAL_KEYSSQL_TASK_TIMEOUT = timedelta(minutes=18)_load_config(config_path: Path) -> dict[str, object]🠖_dag_id(config_path: Path) -> str🠖_build_dag(config_path: Path) -> DAG_discover_dags(config_dir: Path = CONFIG_DIR) -> dict[str, DAG]🠖globals().update(_discover_dags())
